collection.name: declarative-mapping-lab
collection.description: Echo backend for the declarative-mapping-lab integration scenario (vnext #1229: declarative input/output task mappings)

mocks.description: Echoes the request body/header fields the declarative input mapping wrote, plus a fixed score/level for the output mapping. customerName is guarded: a template that reads a member of a missing object renders nothing (X-Mocklab-Template-Error) and the task gets raw text
